objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-firewall-rule-added
objects.description: This detection identifies instances where a Windows Firewall rule is added by monitoring Event ID 4946 in the Windows Security Event Log. Firewall rule modifications can indicate legitimate administrative actions, but they may also signal unauthorized changes, misconfigurations, or malicious activity such as attackers allowing traffic for backdoors or persistence mechanisms.
